name: The St. Regis Punta Mita Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on Mexico's exclusive Punta Mita peninsula, where the Pacific meets luxury on pristine Bahía de Banderas.
whats_special: The resort features the only Jack Nicklaus Signature golf course in Mexico with an optional island green (Hole 3B) accessible only by amphibious cart. The property also boasts Mexico's first Remède Spa and offers exclusive access to two championship golf courses within the gated Punta Mita community.
pro_tip: Book the famous "Tail of the Whale" golf hole experience during whale watching season (December-March) for the ultimate combination of sport and nature spectacle.
dont_miss: The nearby Islas Marietas National Park, where you can snorkel at the hidden Playa del Amor (Lover's Beach), and the charming fishing village of Sayulita, just 20 minutes away, known for its vibrant art scene and world-class surfing breaks.
pros: Signature St. Regis butler service and legendary hospitality
Jack Nicklaus-designed championship golf course with ocean views
Private beach access on pristine Bahía de Banderas coastline
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional Mexican treatments
cons: Remote location requires transportation to local attractions
